note: First action of the orchestrator for one message. allowed_new lists tool names, 'read_file:<path>' for loading a skill, and 'answer' for replying without a tool. allowed_old is the same for the earlier Copilot (its 19 tools, plus 'final' and 'ask'). A case passes when every call in the first action is allowed and, for a call-less reply, 'answer' (or 'final'/'ask') is allowed.
